contract.desired_behavior: Case-insensitive pattern matches, default does not; captures remain Guide and Read and unrelated fragment remains excluded.
contract.distinctness: One option-propagation mechanism with a within-case control; the two options do not count as two designs.
fixed_runtime_assertions: t.equal(insensitive.test(input), true, 'ignoreCase applies to pathname query and fragment components');
t.equal(sensitive.test(input), false, 'default pattern preserves case sensitivity outside canonicalized hostname');
t.equal(result.pathname.groups.page, 'Guide', 'case-insensitive matching preserves captured input spelling');
t.equal(result.hash.input, 'top', 'result stores actual canonicalized fragment input');
t.equal(insensitive.test('https://docs.example.test/docs/Guide?mode=Read#other'), false, 'case folding does not disable component constraints');
contract.hypothesis: ignoreCase may apply only to a subset of components or normalize the text returned in captures.

contract.ordinary_input_scope: Successful public API calls on complete ordinary URL strings or valid property, pair, and pattern inputs. Valid URL nonmatches are intentional boolean/null outcomes, never malformed-input probes. Example domains and documentation IPv6 addresses are data only.

External finite-deadline supervisor and owned-process cleanup are available; missing runtime prerequisites are BLOCKED.
